scope: Exact fair-draw experiment at a fixed budget of ten distinct tickets. No historical prediction, ticket purchase, or payout assumption.
primary_objective: At least one ticket with three or more main matches
secondary_objective: At least one ticket with three or more main matches and the strong number
comparison: Every search starts from its saved portfolio; equal proposal counts, measured runtimes, no equal-wall-time claim. Preserve every result, including failures to improve.
strong_assignment: Exact partition optimization across all seven strong labels for each fixed main portfolio; also evaluate the baseline assignments. Main numbers and jackpot probability remain fixed.
verification: Independently enumerate all 2,324,784 main outcomes for each final main portfolio; independently verify strong-event coverage for every baseline and the selected final portfolio.
selection: Choose maximum exact primary coverage, then maximum exact secondary coverage, then first run in deterministic order. Recheck the selected portfolio with the reference evaluator.
limits: A secondary-event gain is not a gain in overall win probability or expected payout. Exact odds assume uniform draws. No claim of a global optimum for main-number coverage. No tuning or extra runs based on results.
